scripts.build: node scripts/check-rtl.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/check-bundles.ts prototype
scripts.build:server: vite build -c vite.server.config.ts && node scripts/check-bundles.ts server
scripts.test: bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run npm-test -- vitest run --project unit --project server
scripts.test:server: bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-server -- vitest run --project server
scripts.test:db: MADAR_DB=1 bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-db -- vitest run --project db
scripts.test:lite: MADAR_LITE=1 bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-lite -- vitest run --project lite
scripts.test:office: MADAR_OFFICE=1 bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-office -- vitest run --project office
scripts.smoke: bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run smoke -- playwright test
scripts.test:it: MADAR_IT=1 bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-it -- vitest run --project it --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:mcp: bash scripts/dev/heavy-lock.sh run test-mcp -- sh -c 'vitest run --project server server/mcp && tsx server/mcp/conformance.ts'
